style.vernacular: Hot arid Red Sea port city (founded 1888) mixing French colonial, Yemeni and modern blocks: low to mid-rise flat-roofed buildings in white, cream and sun-bleached pastel render, arcaded Moorish-style squares in the centre (Place du 27 Juin), shuttered balconies on older Ras-Dika fronts, plain concrete-block houses and corrugated-iron sheds in Balbala, sand-coloured ground with sparse palms and acacia.
style.ornament: Moorish pointed and horseshoe arches and arcades around Place du 27 Juin, Yemeni-style timber shutters and balconies on older buildings, minimal ornament on newer concrete blocks; colours are sun-bleached rather than saturated. Hex values are inferred from the described white/cream/pastel look, not sampled from photos.

sources.what: architecture blends native, Yemeni, French and modern; Moorish-inspired Place of 27 June; arid hot desert climate; 1949 grid plan
founded by the French 1888, three communes Ras-Dika, Boulaos, Balbala; hot desert climate
